" alt="Devi with bright blue eyes in his conductor uniform">
<div id="speech"><b>DEVI</b>Tiny. Why are you carrying a bottle of tequila onto the locomotive?</div>
<div id="trackLabels"><div class="trackLabel" data-lane="0">LEFT</div><div class="trackLabel chosen" data-lane="1">CENTRE</div><div class="trackLabel" data-lane="2">RIGHT</div></div>
<div id="dash"><div id="pressureArea"><div id="pressureHead"><span>🔥 BOILER</span><span id="pressureVal">38%</span></div><div id="pressureTrack"><i id="pressureFill"></i></div></div><button id="vent" type="button">💨 VENT STEAM</button></div><div id="boardFlash"></div><div id="feedback"></div>
<div id="panicCard"><h2>🚨 RACCOON ON SIGNAL LEVER!</h2><p>DECIDE BEFORE HE CHANGES THE TRACKS</p><span id="panicSeconds">5.0</span></div></section>
<footer id="bottom"><div id="narration"><div id="kicker">STAGE 4 • TINY &amp; DEVI</div><div id="speaker">DEVI</div><div id="message">Tiny. Why are you carrying a bottle of tequila onto the locomotive?</div></div><div id="controls"><button class="action" id="nextBtn">NEXT ▶</button></div><div id="brakePanel"><button id="brakeBtn">✋ HOLD BRAKE</button><small>Brake <span id="brakeVal">100</span>%</small><div id="brakeTrack"><i id="brakeFill" style="width:100%"></i></div></div></footer>
<div id="toast" role="status"></div><section id="overlay" role="dialog" aria-label="Game instructions or pause"><div id="overlayBox"></div></section>
</main><script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),clamp=(n,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,n)),rnd=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);const L=['LEFT','CENTRE','RIGHT'];
const DIALOGUE=[['Devi','Tiny. Why are you carrying a bottle of tequila onto the locomotive?'],['Tiny','Emergency supplies! It is SEALED. I am a PROFESSIONAL.'],['Devi','Then it can stay sealed and safely away from the controls.'],['Tiny','Great. Who has the train keys?'],['Devi','A raccoon, apparently. I am choosing not to ask further questions.'],['Tiny','Perfect! I will steer. You can be the voice of... emotional support.']];
const TEMPLATES=[
 ['FALLEN SIGN','🪧','single'],['LOST LUGGAGE','🧳','single'],['RACCOON CART','🛒','single'],['LOW BRIDGE','🚧','duck'],['BARREL PILE','🛢️','double'],['THE CROWN','👑','double'],['RACCOON PARADE','🦝','double'],['LOW BANNER','🎏','duck'],['UNATTENDED TROLLEY','🚋','single'],
 ['ROLLING APPLES','🍎','single'],['MOP BUCKET','🪣','single'],['GOLDEN SUITCASE','💼','double'],['DINO NUGGET CRATE','📦','single'],['GIANT FLOWER POT','🪴','single'],['FLYING FLAG','🚩','duck'],['MYSTERY MUSHROOMS','🍄','double'],['STOLEN CROWN BOX','🎁','single'],['CHICKEN CROSSING','🐔','double'],['SHORT TUNNEL','🌉','duck'],['DRAMA LLAMA','🦙','single'],['WANDERING COW','🐄','double'],['VERY LOW SIGN','🪧','duck'],['COFFEE CART','☕','single'],['RAIN OF CONFETTI','🎊','single'],['BANANA DELIVERY','🍌','double'],['LEFTOVER THRONE','🪑','single'],['SEAGULL CONVENTION','🐦','double'],['VERY IMPORTANT BOX','📦','single']
];
const APPROACH_DISTANCE=5.0;
const g={phase:'intro',paused:false,overlay:'',sound:false,storyIndex:0,plan:'',energy:35,score:0,hit:0,cleared:0,bonus:0,vents:0,overheat:0,pressure:38,brake:100,braking:false,lane:1,duck:0,duckCooldown:0,elapsed:0,distance:0,nextSpawnAt:.05,spawned:0,resolved:0,total:24,events:[],active:[],panicDone:false,panicTriggered:false,panicTime:0,panicResult:'',travelHeld:false,done:false,assist:0,shield:0,clock:0,lastHazardId:-1};
let last=0,raf=0,toastTimeout=null,audioCtx=null,speechTimeout=0,feedbackTimeout=0;
const shuffle=a=>{for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a};
function buildDeck(){
 const ducks=shuffle(TEMPLATES.filter(t=>t[2]==='duck').map(t=>t.slice()));
 const lanePool=shuffle(TEMPLATES.filter(t=>t[2]!=='duck').map(t=>t.slice()));
 let selected=[];
 for(let wave=0;wave<3;wave++){
  const duckCount=wave===2?2:1;
  const mix=lanePool.splice(0,8-duckCount).concat(ducks.splice(0,duckCount));
  selected.push(...shuffle(mix));
 }
 return selected.map((t,i)=>{
  const free=Math.floor(rnd(0,3)),bad=Math.floor(rnd(0,3));
  const blocked=t[2]==='duck'?[]:t[2]==='double'?[0,1,2].filter(j=>j!==free):[bad];
  return {id:i,name:t[0],icon:t[1],duck:t[2]==='duck',blocked,spawnAt:0,progress:0,els:[],scored:false};
 });
}
function setControls(items,driving=false){const area=$('controls');area.classList.toggle('driving',driving);area.replaceChildren();for(const [label,fn,kind] of items){const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='action'+(kind?' '+kind:'');b.textContent=label;b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(g.paused||g.overlay)return;beep(660,.045);fn()});area.append(b)}return area}
function line(name,words,label='STAGE 4 • TINY & DEVI',short=false){$('speaker').textContent=name.toUpperCase();$('message').textContent=words;$('kicker').textContent=label;const s=$('speech');s.innerHTML='<b>'+name.toUpperCase()+'</b>'+escapeHTML(words);s.classList.remove('hidden');s.classList.toggle('radio',short);speechTimeout=short?2.2:0;}
function escapeHTML(s){return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
function hud(){$('chaos').textContent='CHAOS '+g.score.toLocaleString();$('energy').textContent='⚡ '+Math.round(g.energy)+'/100';$('energyFill').style.width=g.energy+'%';$('topCounter').textContent='DISASTERS '+g.resolved+' / '+g.total;}
function toast(s,secs=1.3){$('toast').textContent=s;$('toast').style.display='block';clearTimeout(toastTimeout);toastTimeout=setTimeout(()=>$('toast').style.display='none',secs*1000)}
function beep(hz,d=.07){if(!g.sound)return;try{audioCtx=audioCtx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(),a=audioCtx.createGain();o.type='sine';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(hz,audioCtx.currentTime);a.gain.setValueAtTime(.05,audioCtx.currentTime);a.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,audioCtx.currentTime+d);o.connect(a);a.connect(audioCtx.destination);o.start();o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+d)}catch(e){}}
function flash(s,type='good',secs=.65){const f=$('feedback');f.className='show '+type;f.textContent=s;clearTimeout(feedbackTimeout);feedbackTimeout=setTimeout(()=>f.className='',secs*1000)}
function modal(type){g.overlay=type;g.paused=true;g.braking=false;const wrap=$('overlay'),box=$('overlayBox');wrap.classList.add('show');let txt='';if(type==='help'){txt='<button id="guideClose" aria-label="Close help">✕</button><h2>🚂 KEEP THE CHAOS EXPRESS MOVING</h2><p>Lane objects can block <b>one or two tracks</b>. Pick a <b style="color:#9ef5c3">CLEAR</b> lane before each reaches you. The <b>bright HIT LINE</b> across the three tracks is where a lane obstacle hits. Switch to a <b style="color:#9ef5c3">GREEN</b> track <b>before it crosses the line</b>. The top banner shows seconds until impact. A <b>full-width striped bar</b> means DUCK before it reaches the same line, never switch lanes to dodge it. <b>HOLD BRAKE</b> to slow the entire stream, and <b>VENT STEAM</b> before the boiler overheats.</p><p>Tap LEFT, CENTRE, RIGHT, DUCK. Swipe left/right/down or use the arrow keys. Up to three threats can be visible in the distance. The closest one is the next impact; watch the time-to-hit warning and the colored segments of the hit line. All 24 hazards are shuffled on replay.</p><button class="action" id="closeBtn">GOT IT • PLAY ▶</button>'}
else {txt='<h2>⏸ TRAIN TEMPORARILY SUPERVISED</h2><p>Even chaos conductors need a short break.</p><button class="action" id="closeBtn">RESUME ▶</button><button class="action secondary" id="restartBtn">RESTART STAGE 4</button>'}
box.innerHTML=txt;const close=()=>{g.overlay='';g.paused=false;wrap.classList.remove('show');g.clock=performance.now()};$('closeBtn').onclick=close;const x=$('guideClose');if(x)x.onclick=close;const restart=$('restartBtn');if(restart)restart.onclick=()=>{close();startNew()};}
function showDialog(){g.phase='intro';$('scene').className='';$('speech').classList.remove('hidden');const d=DIALOGUE[g.storyIndex];if(d){line(d[0],d[1],'OPENING CONVERSATION · '+(g.storyIndex+1)+' / '+DIALOGUE.length);setControls([['NEXT ▶',()=>{g.storyIndex++;showDialog()},'']])}else planMenu()}
function planMenu(){g.phase='plan';line('Devi','I am going to regret this, affectionately.','CHOOSE YOUR RAILWAY STRATEGY');setControls([['TINY DRIVES',()=>plan('tiny'),''],['DEVI READS SIGNALS',()=>plan('devi'),'secondary'],['FOLLOW RACCOON',()=>plan('raccoon'),'secondary']]);}
function plan(p){g.plan=p;if(p==='devi'){g.energy=50;line('Devi','Left means left. Right means right. Please remember that.','PLAN SELECTED')}else if(p==='raccoon'){g.score=110;g.assist=1;line('Tiny','That raccoon looks like he has railway qualifications!','PLAN SELECTED')}else{g.score=140;line('Tiny','The conductor hat makes this OFFICIAL.','PLAN SELECTED')}hud();setControls([['START THE TRAIN ▶',startDrive,'']]);}
function startDrive(){g.phase='ride';g.done=false;g.events=buildDeck();g.active=[];g.resolved=0;g.spawned=0;g.distance=0;g.elapsed=0;g.lastHazardId=-1;g.nextSpawnAt=.06;g.pressure=38;g.brake=100;g.braking=false;g.lane=1;g.duck=0;g.duckCooldown=0;g.panicDone=false;g.panicTriggered=false;g.overheat=0;g.vents=0;g.cleared=0;g.hit=0;g.bonus=0;g.energy=Math.max(35,g.energy);$('scene').className='running';$('speech').classList.add('hidden');$('panicCard').classList.remove('show');$('feedback').className='';$('brakePanel').style.display='flex';$('nearWarning').style.display='block';$('overheadBeam').style.display='none';$('oncoming').replaceChildren();$('trackLabels').style.display='grid';setDrivingControls();hud();renderDash();last=performance.now();cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);}
function setDrivingControls(){setControls([['◀ LEFT',()=>chooseLane(0),'secondary'],['● CENTRE',()=>chooseLane(1),'secondary'],['RIGHT ▶',()=>chooseLane(2),'secondary'],['▼ DUCK',duck,'']],true);renderLabels()}
function chooseLane(n){if(g.phase!=='ride'||g.paused)return;g.lane=n;beep(520,.055);renderLabels()}
function duck(){if(g.phase!=='ride'||g.paused)return;g.duck=1.55;g.duckCooldown=.25;toast('⬇ Tiny DUCKS!');beep(410,.07)}
function brake(down){g.braking=(g.phase==='ride'&&!g.paused&&down&&g.brake>0);$('brakeBtn').classList.toggle('pressed',g.braking)}
function vent(){if(g.phase!=='ride'||g.paused||g.pressure<22)return;g.vents++;let prev=g.pressure;g.pressure=Math.max(9,g.pressure-39);g.score+=(prev>=75?85:20);if(prev>=75)g.energy=clamp(g.energy+5,0,100);toast(prev>=75?'💨 PERFECT VENT! +85':'💨 STEAM RELEASED!');beep(260,.2);renderDash();hud()}
function renderLabels(){
 const pending=g.active.filter(h=>h.progress<1).sort((a,b)=>b.progress-a.progress);
 const soon=pending[0], laneHazard=soon&&!soon.duck?soon:null;
 const danger=laneHazard?laneHazard.blocked:[];
 document.querySelectorAll('.trackLabel').forEach((el,i)=>{
  el.className='trackLabel'+(danger.includes(i)?' danger':'')+(g.lane===i?' chosen':'');
  el.textContent=(g.lane===i?'🚂 ':'')+L[i]+(laneHazard?(danger.includes(i)?' ✕':' ✓'):'');
 });
 const hitLine=$('collisionLine');
 hitLine.classList.toggle('duck',!!soon?.duck);
 const segments=hitLine.querySelectorAll('.impactSegment');
 segments.forEach((seg,i)=>{
  seg.className='impactSegment'+(laneHazard?(danger.includes(i)?' danger':' safe'):'')+(g.lane===i?' chosen':'');
 });
 const hitLabel=hitLine.querySelector('.impactLabel');
 hitLabel.textContent=soon?.duck?'DUCK BEFORE THIS LINE':'HIT LINE • SWITCH BEFORE THIS';
 if(soon&&g.lastHazardId!==soon.id){
  g.lastHazardId=soon.id;
  $('kicker').textContent='INCOMING • '+(g.resolved+1)+' / '+g.total;
  $('speaker').textContent='DEVI';
  $('message').textContent=soon.duck?'Full-width '+soon.name.toLowerCase()+' ahead. DUCK before it reaches the HIT LINE!':soon.name+' ahead. '+L.filter((v,i)=>!danger.includes(i)).join(' or ')+' clear. Switch before it reaches the bright HIT LINE!';
 }
 const w=$('nearWarning');w.style.display='block';
 if(soon){
  const seconds=Math.max(0,(1-soon.progress)*APPROACH_DISTANCE/(g.braking&&g.brake>0?.43:1));
  const time=seconds.toFixed(1)+'s';
  w.className=soon.duck?'duck':'';
  if(soon.duck){
   w.innerHTML='<strong>⬇ '+(seconds<1.6?'DUCK NOW!':'OVERHEAD APPROACHING')+' · '+time+'</strong><small>'+soon.name+' · BAR HITS THE GOLD LINE</small>';
  }else{
   const inDanger=danger.includes(g.lane);
   const urgent=inDanger?(seconds<=1.7?'⚠ SWITCH NOW!':'⚠ SWITCH BEFORE HIT'):'✓ SAFE TRACK';
   w.innerHTML='<strong>'+urgent+' · '+time+' TO HIT</strong><small>'+soon.name+' · SAFE: '+L.filter((v,i)=>!danger.includes(i)).join(' / ')+'</small>';
  }
 }else{w.className='';w.innerHTML='<strong>LOOK AHEAD · HIT LINE BELOW</strong><small>Switch before a hazard reaches the bright line</small>';}
 renderOverhead(pending);
}
function renderOverhead(pending){
 const h=pending.find(x=>x.duck&&x.progress<1&&x.progress>.28);
 const beam=$('overheadBeam');
 if(!h||g.phase!=='ride'){beam.style.display='none';return}
 const p=clamp(h.progress,0,1);
 beam.style.display='flex';beam.style.top=(17+p*57)+'%';
 beam.style.opacity=String(clamp(.50+p*.58,.5,1));
 beam.classList.toggle('imminent',p>=.72);
 $('overheadText').textContent=p>=.72?'DUCK NOW!':h.name+' • DUCK SOON';
}
function renderDash(){$('pressureVal').textContent=Math.round(g.pressure)+'%'+(g.pressure>=80?' ⚠':'');$('pressureFill').style.width=clamp(g.pressure,0,100)+'%';$('pressureFill').classList.toggle('hot',g.pressure>=80);$('brakeVal').textContent=Math.round(g.brake);$('brakeFill').style.width=g.brake+'%';$('vent').disabled=g.pressure<22||g.paused;}
function spawn(h){
 h.spawnAt=g.distance;h.progress=0;h.els=[];
 if(!h.duck){
  for(const lane of h.blocked){
   const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='obstacle';el.setAttribute('aria-label',h.name+' on '+L[lane]);
   el.innerHTML='<span class="shape">'+h.icon+'</span><span class="tag">'+h.name+'</span>';
   el.dataset.lane=lane;h.els.push(el);$('oncoming').append(el);
  }
 }
 g.active.push(h);g.spawned++;
}
function renderObstacle(h){
 if(h.duck)return; // Full-span hazards are drawn in renderOverhead, never on a lane.
 const p=clamp(h.progress,0,1);
 for(const el of h.els){
  const lane=+el.dataset.lane;
  const spread=5+p*18;
  const x=50+(lane-1)*spread;
  const y=32+p*42,scale=.28+p*1.0;
  el.style.left=x+'%';el.style.top=y+'%';el.style.zIndex=12+Math.round(p*11);
  el.style.opacity=clamp((p+.08)*4,0,1);
  el.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) scale('+scale.toFixed(2)+')';
  el.querySelector('.tag').style.display=p>.28?'block':'none';
 }
}
function scoreObstacle(h){
 h.scored=true;
 let safe=h.duck?g.duck>0:!h.blocked.includes(g.lane);
 if(!safe&&g.assist>0){safe=true;g.assist--;toast('🦝 RACCOONS CLEAR THE TRACK!')}
 if(!safe&&g.shield>0){safe=true;g.shield--;toast('🥺 PUPPY EYES SAVED TINY!')}
 if(safe){g.cleared++;g.score+=180;g.energy=clamp(g.energy+7,0,100);
  if(!h.duck&&h.blocked.length===2){g.score+=60;g.bonus++}
  flash('✨ '+h.name+' CLEAR!', 'good',.36);beep(690,.06);
 }else{g.hit++;g.score=Math.max(0,g.score-60);
  flash(h.duck?'💥 DUCK FAIL! DEVI GRABS THE HAT!':'💥 BONK! DEVI SAVES THE TRAIN!', 'bad',.53);
  $('scene').classList.remove('bonk');void $('scene').offsetWidth;$('scene').classList.add('bonk');beep(180,.19);
 }
 for(const el of h.els||[])el.remove();g.resolved++;hud();
}
function nextGap(n){
 // n = count already spawned. Distances are measured in normal-speed seconds.
 const prev=g.events[n-1],next=g.events[n];
 let gap=n<8?rnd(2.1,2.45):n<16?rnd(1.85,2.2):rnd(1.7,2.05);
 if(prev?.duck||next?.duck)gap=Math.max(gap,2.2);
 if(prev?.blocked?.length===2&&next?.blocked?.length===2)gap=Math.max(gap,1.9);
 if(n===8||n===16)gap=Math.max(gap,2.5);
 return gap;
}
function loop(now){raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);const dt=Math.min(.065,Math.max(0,(now-last)/1000));last=now;if(g.phase!=='ride'||g.paused)return;
 let speed=g.braking&&g.brake>0?.43:1;g.elapsed+=dt;g.distance+=speed*dt;g.brake=clamp(g.brake+(g.braking?-27:19)*dt,0,100);if(g.brake===0)brake(false);g.pressure+=dt*(9.2+(g.resolved*.14)+(g.braking?4.5:0));g.duck=Math.max(0,g.duck-dt);g.duckCooldown=Math.max(0,g.duckCooldown-dt);
 if(g.pressure>=100){g.overheat++;g.pressure=45;g.hit++;flash('💥 BOILER BLAST! DEVI RESCUES US!', 'bad',1);beep(150,.22);$('scene').classList.remove('shake');void $('scene').offsetWidth;$('scene').classList.add('shake')}
 while(g.spawned<g.total&&g.distance>=g.nextSpawnAt){spawn(g.events[g.spawned]);g.nextSpawnAt+=nextGap(g.spawned)}
 for(const h of g.active){h.progress=(g.distance-h.spawnAt)/APPROACH_DISTANCE;renderObstacle(h)}
 const passed=g.active.filter(h=>h.progress>=1);for(const h of passed)scoreObstacle(h);if(passed.length)g.active=g.active.filter(h=>h.progress<1);
 renderDash();renderLabels();if(g.resolved>=12&&!g.panicDone&&!g.panicTriggered){beginPanic();return}
 if(g.resolved===g.total&&g.active.length===0){endStage();return}
 if(speechTimeout>0){speechTimeout-=dt;if(speechTimeout<=0)$('speech').classList.add('hidden')}
}
function beginPanic(){g.phase='panic';g.panicTriggered=true;g.braking=false;$('brakeBtn').classList.remove('pressed');$('scene').classList.add('crisis');$('panicCard').classList.add('show');$('overheadBeam').style.display='none';g.panicTime=5.2;line('Devi','Why is that raccoon pulling the signal lever?!','SURPRISE PANIC DECISION',true);setControls([['DEVI, TAKE OVER',()=>resolvePanic('devi'),''],['BRAKE & CHECK',()=>resolvePanic('brake'),'secondary'],['YELL AT RACCOON',()=>resolvePanic('raccoon'),'secondary']]);last=performance.now();}
function resolvePanic(choice){if(g.phase!=='panic')return;g.panicDone=true;g.panicResult=choice;g.phase='interlude';$('panicCard').classList.remove('show');$('scene').classList.remove('crisis');if(choice==='devi'){g.score+=170;g.assist++;line('Devi','I have the controls. You can stop conducting traffic with your empty glass.','PANIC RESOLVED')}else if(choice==='brake'){g.score+=170;g.brake=100;line('Tiny','See? BRAKES! I knew we had those!','PANIC RESOLVED')}else if(choice==='raccoon'){g.score+=240;line('Tiny','SIR. YOU ARE NOT A LICENSED SIGNAL OPERATOR.','PANIC RESOLVED')}else{g.hit++;line('Devi','Tiny. The train is STILL MOVING.','PANIC CONSEQUENCE')}
 hud();setControls([['BACK TO THE TRACKS ▶',resumeDrive,'']]);}
function resumeDrive(){g.phase='ride';$('speech').classList.add('hidden');setDrivingControls();last=performance.now()}
function endStage(){g.phase='finished';g.done=true;g.braking=false;$('brakeBtn').classList.remove('pressed');$('brakePanel').style.display='none';$('oncoming').replaceChildren();$('nearWarning').style.display='none';$('overheadBeam').style.display='none';$('trackLabels').style.display='none';$('scene').classList.remove('running');g.score+=g.hit===0?350:g.hit<=3?140:0;hud();line('Devi',g.hit===0?'You did surprisingly well. I am genuinely impressed.':'Well. We arrived. That is technically a success.','STAGE 4 COMPLETE');setControls([['VIEW INCIDENT REPORT ▶',report,'']]);}
function report(){g.phase='report';const safety=g.cleared+'/'+g.total;line('Tiny','We are TRAIN PROFESSIONALS! Noosh will never believe us.','STAGE 4 COMPLETE');$('message').textContent=`${safety} hazards cleared • ${g.hit} collisions/boiler incidents • ${g.vents} steam vents • ${g.score.toLocaleString()} chaos points. Next stop: Baba’s showdown!`;setControls([['CONTINUE TO STAGE 5 ▸',()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_STAGE_DONE',stage:4,score:g.score,energy:g.energy,meta:{cleared:g.cleared,total:g.total,hit:g.hit,vents:g.vents,bonus:g.bonus,plan:g.plan}},'*'),''],['REPLAY STAGE 4 ↻',startNew,'']]);}
function startNew(){cancelAnimationFrame(raf);g.phase='intro';g.overlay='';g.paused=false;g.storyIndex=0;g.score=0;g.energy=Number.isFinite(window.__tinyInheritedEnergy)?window.__tinyInheritedEnergy:35;g.vents=0;g.done=false;g.resolved=0;g.spawned=0;g.panicDone=false;g.active=[];$('overlay').classList.remove('show');$('scene').className='';$('oncoming').replaceChildren();$('nearWarning').style.display='none';$('overheadBeam').style.display='none';$('collisionLine').className='';$('trackLabels').style.display='grid';$('brakePanel').style.display='none';$('feedback').className='';$('speech').className='';$('panicCard').classList.remove('show');hud();showDialog();}
$('vent').onclick=vent;$('pauseBtn').onclick=()=>{if(g.phase==='intro'||g.phase==='report')return;if(g.overlay){$('closeBtn')?.click();return}modal('pause')};$('helpBtn').onclick=()=>modal('help');$('soundBtn').onclick=()=>{g.sound=!g.sound;$('soundBtn').textContent=g.sound?'🔊':'♫';if(g.sound)beep(540,.1)};
$('fullBtn').onclick=()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_TOGGLE_FULLSCREEN'},'*');
const bb=$('brakeBtn');for(const e of ['pointerdown','touchstart'])bb.addEventListener(e,ev=>{if(e==='pointerdown')bb.setPointerCapture?.(ev.pointerId);if(e==='touchstart')ev.preventDefault();brake(true)},{passive:false});for(const e of ['pointerup','pointercancel','pointerleave','touchend','touchcancel'])bb.addEventListener(e,()=>brake(false));window.addEventListener('blur',()=>brake(false));
let startX=0,startY=0;$('scene').addEventListener('touchstart',ev=>{if(ev.touches.length!==1)return;startX=ev.touches[0].clientX;startY=ev.touches[0].clientY},{passive:true});$('scene').addEventListener('touchend',ev=>{if(g.phase!=='ride'||g.paused)return;const p=ev.changedTouches[0];if(!p)return;let dx=p.clientX-startX,dy=p.clientY-startY;if(Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy))<28)return;if(Math.abs(dy)>Math.abs(dx)&&dy>15)duck();else if(Math.abs(dx)>20)chooseLane(clamp(g.lane+(dx>0?1:-1),0,2))},{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('keydown',ev=>{if(g.overlay){if(ev.key==='Escape'||ev.key==='Enter')$('closeBtn')?.click();return}if(g.phase==='ride'){if(ev.key==='ArrowLeft'||ev.key.toLowerCase()==='a')chooseLane(clamp(g.lane-1,0,2));if(ev.key==='ArrowRight'||ev.key.toLowerCase()==='d')chooseLane(clamp(g.lane+1,0,2));if(ev.key==='ArrowDown'||ev.key===' ')duck();if(ev.key.toLowerCase()==='v')vent();if(ev.key.toLowerCase()==='b')brake(true)}if(ev.key==='Escape')modal('pause')});window.addEventListener('keyup',ev=>{if(ev.key.toLowerCase()==='b')brake(false)});
const panicTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(g.phase!=='panic'||g.paused)return;g.panicTime-=.08;$('panicSeconds').textContent=Math.max(0,g.panicTime).toFixed(1);if(g.panicTime<=0)resolvePanic('freeze')},80);
const originalAlert=window.__debugStage4={g,buildDeck,startDrive,chooseLane,duck,vent,brake,resolvePanic,report,startNew,fastForward:(distance)=>{g.distance=distance},step:(frames=1)=>{for(let i=0;i<frames;i++){cancelAnimationFrame(raf);loop(last+65);cancelAnimationFrame(raf)}},getObstacles:()=>g.active.map(h=>({name:h.name,progress:h.progress,blocked:h.blocked,duck:h.duck}))};
startNew();
})();</script></body></html>
